x.label: Control: centralized → decentralized
x.definition: 0.7 × rule score parsed from control_flow (centralized≈0.08, hierarchical≈0.28, hybrid≈0.5, decentralized≈0.92, averaged over matched terms) + 0.3 × rank-normalised embedding projection onto the anchor axis 'single central orchestrator' → 'autonomous peers, no controller'.

y.label: Coordination: fixed workflow → conversational/deliberative → emergent/evolutionary
y.definition: 0.55 × category prior (e.g. Pipeline 0.05, Conversational 0.55, Evolutionary 0.9, Classical swarm 0.95) + 0.45 × rank-normalised soft-assignment of the structure's embedding to three anchor descriptions (fixed workflow=0, conversational=0.5, emergent/evolutionary=1).

axes.color: category (alternatives in viewer: complexity, research fit, scraping fit)
axes.note: Displayed positions are slightly decluttered (repulsion) from the raw scores; raw scores are in axes_x_raw/axes_y_raw.
